Hi Clara —

Thanks again for taking time to chat today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed set of next steps so we can keep the procurement and security review moving: 

Summary / takeaway from call:
- Acme Health is evaluating Redwood for patient-facing summarization and clinical note generation (HIPAA scope).
- Key security asks: SOC 2 status, HIPAA BAA, data residency, and whether Redwood supports customer-managed keys (CMK/BYOK/HSM).

Open items we promised to follow up on: 
1) SOC 2: current state and timing for report delivery.
2) HIPAA: BAA process and typical timeline for execution.
3) Encryption/KMS: options for at-rest encryption with customer-managed keys (AWS KMS, HSM), key rotation, and audit logging (CloudTrail).
4) Vendor security questionnaire: you asked for our initial answers + a copy for your vendor team. 

Next steps (proposed):
- I attached the vendor security questionnaire (stub) you mentioned. If you can send the version your procurement team uses, we’ll populate it and return within 2 business days.
- I’m looping in Aditya (redwood infra/security) for the KMS technical details — he can jump on an implementation call to discuss CMK and HSM options.
- If it helps, we can schedule a 30-min follow-up next week to walk through the answers and any specific needs around BAA/PHI handling.

Suggested times: Thu 3/5 10–11am PT or Fri 3/6 9–11am PT. Let me know what works.

Marissa —

Appreciate the recap and the quick turnaround. A few answers from our side to help prioritize: 
- SOC 2: We require SOC 2 Type II. If you have a current report (within last 12 months), please share. If not, note it as "in progress" and provide expected completion date.
- HIPAA/BAA: We must have an executed BAA prior to production with PHI. Procurement will need the standard BAA template and typical turnaround is 2–3 weeks once redlines are minimal.
- KMS/Encryption: Strong preference for customer-managed keys. We currently use AWS KMS CMKs for our other vendors; HSM-backed keys preferred for critical data. Key rotation policies and evidence of access controls/CloudTrail logs are required.

I attached our vendor questionnaire (we'll send the official PDF via procurement). Please fill it out and return — procurement wants initial answers before the call.

We can do Thu 3/5 10am PT. Please send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Clara Jensen
Director of Security & Compliance | Acme Health

Hi Clara —

Following up with the technical details we discussed. I’ll be on the call Thu at 10am PT to walk through these, but wanted to put key points in writing so procurement/security has something to review in advance: 

Encryption overview:
- In-transit: TLS 1.2+ with strong cipher suites; mutual TLS available for private peering.
- At-rest: AES-256. Each customer has a unique encryption domain.

Customer-managed keys (CMK) support:
- Hosted (Redwood cloud): we support AWS KMS CMKs via a customer-owned AWS account (cross-account key policy). This enables you to manage key lifecycle and rotate keys on your schedule.
- Dedicated/Private: option to integrate with HSM-backed KMS or your on-prem HSM (PKCS#11) for true hardware-backed keys; Redwood can be configured to use those keys for at-rest encryption and for wrapping model cache keys.
- BYOK/HSM note: we support importable keys and external HSMs for private deployments; for hosted, we recommend customer-owned KMS with cross-account pattern (we do not hold the plain-text key material).

Auditability & logging:
- Every KMS Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey operation can be logged to CloudTrail; we can provide cross-account CloudTrail access or deliver logs to an S3 bucket you control.
- Key usage metrics and rotation history are available via our admin console and can be exported for your audits.

Operational controls:
- Key rotation: supports automated rotation (customer-configurable interval) and manual rotation with documented key rollover procedures.
- Access control: fine-grained IAM roles + RBAC inside Redwood; HSM-backed keys require admin approval flows.
- Evidence: we can provide sample CloudTrail artifacts, config screenshots, and a short architecture diagram for procurement. Link: https://redwood.app/docs/kms-integration-specs

If you want, we can prepare a short demo of cross-account KMS setup before the call — about 15 minutes. Otherwise I’ll walk through the steps during our scheduled meeting.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Senior Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
